title: Compliance burnup forecasts and simulated-drill playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a cycle-level burnup forecast dashboard and an operational playbook for running two compliance simulation drills (SOC2 and ISO) before the end of the quarter. This ticket covers: 1) a forecast model for milestone burnup that accounts for evidence collection velocity and cross-team review latency; 2) a prioritized checklist for each drill (SSO/SAML, audit log retention, evidence retrieval); 3) rollback and escalation triggers tied to milestone health; 4) a communications and approvals matrix for exec sign-off. The goal is to reduce last-mile surprise risk for enterprise onboarding and demonstrate a repeatable drill cadence tied to our OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: Forecast dashboard shows burndown and 3-week probabilistic completion percentiles for SOC2 and ISO milestone buckets
Two simulated drills executed with post-mortem and runbook updates recorded in Confluence
Rollback triggers defined and wired into on-call escalation (PagerDuty link) and update flows in Console
Stakeholders (security, infra, product, support) have runbook sign-off and the playbook is included in the compliance evidence bucket
comments: 2025-02-12 — Aisha Patel: Kickoff scheduled with Security and Infra. Initial scope agreed: include SSO/SAML, auditlog retention, and evidence retrieval. Noted need to model cross-team review latency separately from engineering delivery velocity.

2025-02-15 — Marco Chen: Drafted burnup forecast prototype in Grafana using historical evidence ingestion rates. Early finding: manual evidence reviews introduce a 2–4 day tail in completion. Proposal: add a 'review buffer' in the forecast algorithm to reduce false optimism.
2025-02-17 — Priya Rao (Security): Reviewed checklist draft; asked to add explicit KMS/HSM verification steps for Private deployments. Marked 'high' on customer_impact for regulated customers.

2025-02-19 — Engineering sync (ENG owners): Decided to scope two automation stories (ENG-22111, ENG-22345) to reduce manual evidence collection. Trade-off: automation may require additional QA delaying first drill by one sprint; accepted as lower risk than flaky manual runs.
2025-02-21 — Design review (DES-410): Provided a lightweight runbook template and approval banner for the Console. Feedback: keep the runbook mobile-friendly for on-call engineers.

2025-02-24 — Marco Chen: Opened PR to add forecast panels (https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/12345). Requesting visibility from Product and Security for threshold tuning. Next: schedule first tabletop drill for 2025-03-10.
2025-02-25 — VP Product (Elena Martinez): Approved drill cadence and requested executive summary slides. Action: deliver 5-slide briefing by 2025-03-05.

2025-02-27 — Marco Chen: Updated playbook with rollback triggers. Rollback criteria include: evidence ingestion < 50% forecast OR unresolved P1 security findings. PagerDuty escalation mapped to SRE rotation. Marking this ticket as high-priority for cycle planning.
roadmap_notes: This work fills a gap in our Assurance & Compliance roadmap: formalizing milestone health telemetry and linking it to operational drills. Will be used as a template for future compliance waves and private deployment onboarding.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Automation stories slip -> mitigation: run one drill in hybrid mode (automation + manual verification)
Risk: Incomplete stakeholder sign-off -> mitigation: require pre-drill approval gate and use the exec briefing to accelerate sign-off
Risk: Forecast model overfits historical data -> mitigation: surface conservative percentile (30th) in status reports and iterate after first drill

Schedule tabletop drill and send invites to stakeholders (target 2025-03-10)
